segments.name: Portfolio investments
segments.description: Provides customized debt and equity financing to lower middle-market companies, earning investment income from portfolio investments.
segments.evidence: the Company is externally managed and has determined that it has a single reporting segment and operating unit structure, which derives investment income from its portfolio investments.

revenueModel.text: Portfolio companies pay the company interest, dividends and fees on its debt and equity investments.
revenueModel.evidence: Interest and dividend income are recorded on the accrual basis to the extent that the Company expects to collect such amounts.
